arguments.content:
# Linux swipe-to-seek crumb feedback.
screen void
# Start playback (no need for audio correctness; fixtures provide duration).
play /opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus
# Wait a moment for the UI to mount (settle frames).
frames
# Drag the hero horizontally to scrubbing; crumb should show target/duration/progress.
call ext.nothingness.dragByKey key=void-hero-gesture dx=180 dy=0 steps=18
shoot during_swipe_seek_crumb
# Give the app some time for the end-of-gesture clear timer to elapse.
pause
shoot post_swipe_seek_crumb
overflows
